resolved_config.description: Phase A operational latency benchmark on capped raw-PCAP first-window test flows under session/scenario-disjoint evaluation.

claim_boundaries.paper_replication: Reconstructs MontazeriShatoori et al. (2020) packet-clumping LSTM (DoHLyzer v4.py) with 1ms clumping timeout, reference feature order [interarrival, duration, size, packet_count, direction], and flow-random 80/20 split. Marked with explicit data leakage caveat due to cross-partition session overlap.
claim_boundaries.reference_facts: DoHLyzer v4.py reference implementation architecture: Dense(10, ReLU) -> LSTM(8*l, ReLU) -> Dense(6*l, ReLU) -> Dropout(0.2) -> Dense(2*l, ReLU) -> Dense(1, Sigmoid). Normalization formulas verified from DoHLyzer analyzer/dataset.py. Training hyperparameters (Adam, learning rate, batch size, epochs, patience) were omitted in the published paper and represent project decisions.
claim_boundaries.project_improvements: Corrected evaluation protocol: Session/scenario-disjoint 70/15/15 group split proving zero session overlap across partitions; mask-aware Bidirectional GRU model with attention pooling; class-weighted BCE loss; validation-only Platt probability calibration and decision threshold selection under strict target FPR constraint (FPR <= 0.001). Never tunes threshold on test data.
claim_boundaries.operational_latency: Phase A operational latency microbenchmarks measured on first-window-per-test-flow samples with batch size 1, warm-up iterations, and CUDA synchronization. Evaluates traffic collection delay (physical clump network observation time), sequence preprocessing, and PyTorch model forward pass. Traffic collection delay is derived from clump timestamps/durations; preprocessing and inference are timed in-memory without disk I/O.
